[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided steps to track YouTube live stream analytics:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Navigate to Analytics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Select the "Live" tab.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Choose a time period.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. View live stream metrics: concurrent viewers, peak concurrent viewers, average view duration, watch time, engagement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Drill down into individual streams.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Use the "Compare" feature.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided pros and cons of daily live streams:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros: Increased visibility, consistency, improved skills, more opportunities for interaction.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cons: Burnout, content fatigue, quality over quantity, technical issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested alternatives to daily live streams: 3-4 times a week, themed streams, batch streaming.
